rules.stableId: <category>-<jurisdiction-slug>-<lowest-included-CRD-OBJECTID>; explicit id and full sourceObjectIds are frozen here
rules.duplicateKey: source Type + Jurisdic + NFKD/case-folded alphanumeric-normalized Name
rules.sameNameMerge: include only if exact-touching/overlapping source features form one connected feature group, or a jurisdiction-maintained exact named boundary overlaps every source polygon by at least 70 percent; otherwise hold
rules.geometry: merge polygons only with polygon-clipping union; no buffers, convex hulls or synthetic connections; preserve disjoint parts and holes
rules.semanticScreen: exclude generic labels, unconfirmed road parcels, access and trail-only land, park reserves, and standalone infrastructure/facilities listed by their per-entry reason
rules.parkDestinationScreen: Hold source records without the word Park in the source name unless a reviewed jurisdiction-maintained named park boundary confirms the destination; separately exclude named non-destination facilities and access/corridor parcels with explicit per-entry reasons.
